reviewer.name: Uwe Wahser

anchor.note: p.199 ff. l.33 - 40 read as the printed page; section 2 does NOT agree

public.text: The first paragraph contains a lot of negativity towards existing systems. The statements are true and relevant, but might cause the reader to associate this with the proposed solution.
public.suggestedRevision: Try to formulate sentences in a positive way in favor of a BPR, mentioning the drawbacks of existing systems e.g. as examples in a half sentnece afterwards. E.g. Instead of "In most countries today, that knowledge is fragemented" write "A BPR unifies documentation about benefit schemes, donor agreements etc in a single registry, while in many countriies today that knowledge is fragmented."
